The '''Med'soto style''' was an [[Architect/Legends|architectural]] style<ref name="CSWE" /> that was once common during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]<ref name="DB" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SV" />

At some point between [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] and [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|cook]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] renovated his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|54|COR 23-26|Coruscant – Dex's Diner}}</ref> in the early Med'soto style, which was characterized by bright lights, [[chrome]] accents, and tiled floors.<ref name="CatCW" /> By this [[Time/Legends|time]], it was considered a nostalgic style that recalled the golden days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="DD">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>
